G4100.def: from «4102»; to have faith (in, upon, or with respect to, a person or thing), i.e. credit; by implication, to entrust (especially one's spiritual well-being to Christ):--believe(-r), commit (to trust), put in trust with.

G4102.def: from «3982»; persuasion, i.e. credence; moral conviction (of religious truth, or the truthfulness of God or a religious teacher), especially reliance upon Christ for salvation; abstractly, constancy in such profession; by extension, the system of religious (Gospel) truth itself:--assurance, belief, believe, faith, fidelity.

G4103.def: from «3982»; objectively, trustworthy; subjectively, trustful:--believe(-ing, -r), faithful(-ly), sure, true.

G4105.def: from «4106»; to (properly, cause to) roam (from safety, truth, or virtue):--go astray, deceive, err, seduce, wander, be out of the way.

G4106.def: feminine of «4108» (as abstractly); objectively, fraudulence; subjectively, a straying from orthodoxy or piety:--deceit, to deceive, delusion, error.

G4107.def: from «4108»; a rover ("planet"), i.e. (figuratively) an erratic teacher:--wandering.

G4108.def: of uncertain affinity; roving (as a tramp), i.e. (by implication) an impostor or misleader; --deceiver, seducing.

G4109.def: from «4111»; a moulding-board, i.e. flat surface ("plate", or tablet, literally or figuratively):--table.

G4111.def: a primary verb; to mould, i.e. shape or fabricate:--form.

G4112.def: from «4111»; moulded, i.e. (by implication) artificial or (figuratively) fictitious (false):--feigned.

G4113.def: feminine of «4116»; a wide "plat" or "place", i.e. open square:--street.

G4115.def: from «4116»; to widen (literally or figuratively):--make broad, enlarge.

G4118.def: irregular superlative of «4183»; the largest number or very large:--very great, most.

G4119.def: plural) the major portion:--X above, + exceed, more excellent, further, (very) great(-er), long(-er), (very) many, greater (more) part, + yet but.

G4120.def: a primary word; to twine or braid:--plait.

G4121.def: from «4119»; to do, make or be more, i.e. increase (transitively or intransitively); by extension, to superabound:--abound, abundant, make to increase, have over.

G4122.def: from «4123»; to be covetous, i.e. (by implication) to over-reach:--get an advantage, defraud, make a gain.

G4123.def: from «4119» and «2192»; holding (desiring) more, i.e. eager for gain (avaricious, hence a defrauder):--covetous.

G4124.def: from «4123»; avarice, i.e. (by implication) fraudulency, extortion:--covetous(-ness) practices, greediness.

G4125.def: of uncertain affinity; a rib, i.e. (by extension) side:--side.

G4126.et: another form for pleuo {plyoo'-o}, which is used as an alternate in certain tenses, probably a form of (4150) (through the idea of plunging through the water)
G4126.def: probably a form of «4150» (through the idea of plunging through the water); to pass in a vessel:--sail. See also «4130».

G4127.def: from «4141»; a stroke; by implication, a wound; figuratively, a calamity:--plague, stripe, wound(-ed).

G4128.def: from «4130»; a fulness, i.e. a large number, throng, populace:--bundle, company, multitude.

G4129.def: from another form of «4128»; to increase (transitively or intransitively):--abound, multiply.

G4130.pos:
1. to fill
  2. to be fulfilled, to be filled
G4130.def: to "fill" (literally or figuratively (imbue, influence, supply)); specially, to fulfil (time):--accomplish, full (...come), furnish.

G4132.def: prolonged from «4130»; flood-tide, i.e. (by analogy) a freshet:--flood.

G4133.def: from «4119»; moreover (besides), i.e. albeit, save that, rather, yet:--but (rather), except, nevertheless, notwithstanding, save, than.

G4134.def: from «4130»; replete, or covered over; by analogy, complete:--full.

G4135.def: from «4134» and «5409»; to carry out fully (in evidence), i.e. completely assure (or convince), entirely accomplish:--most surely believe, fully know (persuade), make full proof of.

G4137.def: from «4134»; to make replete, i.e. (literally) to cram (a net), level up (a hollow), or (figuratively) to furnish (or imbue, diffuse, influence), satisfy, execute (an office), finish (a period or task), verify (or coincide with a prediction), etc.:--accomplish, × after, (be) complete, end, expire, fill (up), fulfil, (be, make) full (come), fully preach, perfect, supply.

G4138.def: from «4137»; repletion or completion, i.e. (subjectively) what fills (as contents, supplement, copiousness, multitude), or (objectively) what is filled (as container, performance, period):--which is put in to fill up, piece that filled up, fulfilling, full, fulness.

G4139.et: neuter of a derivative of pelas (near)
G4139.def: neuter of a derivative of pelas (near); (adverbially) close by; as noun, a neighbor, i.e. fellow (as man, countryman, Christian or friend):--near, neighbour.

G4140.def: from a presumed derivative of «4130»; a filling up, i.e. (figuratively) gratification:--satisfying.

G4141.et: apparently another form of (4111) (through the idea of flattening out)
G4141.def: apparently another form of «4111» (through the idea of flattening out); to pound, i.e. (figuratively) to inflict with (calamity):--smite. Compare «5180».

G4142.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of «4143»; a boat:--boat, little (small) ship.

G4144.def: from «4126»; a sail, i.e. navigation:--course, sailing, voyage.

G4147.def: from «4148»; to be (or become) wealthy (literally or figuratively):--be increased with goods, (be made, wax) rich.

G4149.def: from the base of «4130»; wealth (as fulness), i.e. (literally) money, possessions, or (figuratively) abundance, richness, (specially), valuable bestowment:--riches.

G4150.et: a prolonged form of an obsolete pluo (to "flow")
G4150.def: a prolonged form of an obsolete pluo (to "flow"); to "plunge", i.e. launder clothing:--wash. Compare «3068», «3538».

G4151.def: from «4154»; a current of air, i.e. breath (blast) or a breeze; by analogy or figuratively, a spirit, i.e. (human) the rational soul, (by implication) vital principle, mental disposition, etc., or (superhuman) an angel, demon, or (divine) God, Christ's spirit, the Holy Spirit:--ghost, life, spirit(-ual, -ually), mind. Compare «5590».

G4152.def: from «4151»; non-carnal, i.e. (humanly) ethereal (as opposed to gross), or (daemoniacally) a spirit (concretely), or (divinely) supernatural, regenerate, religious:--spiritual. Compare «5591».

G4153.def: adverb from «4152»; non-physically, i.e. divinely, figuratively:--spiritually.

G4154.def: a primary word; to breathe hard, i.e. breeze:--blow. Compare «5594».

G4155.def: strengthened from «4154»; to wheeze, i.e. (causative, by implication) to throttle or strangle (drown):--choke, take by the throat.

G4156.def: from «4155»; throttled, i.e. (neuter concretely) an animal choked to death (not bled):--strangled.

G4158.et: from (4228) and another element of uncertain affinity
G4158.def: from «4228» and another element of uncertain affinity; a dress (2066 implied) reaching the ankles:--garment down to the foot.

G4159.et: from the base of (4213) with enclitic adverb of origin
G4159.def: from the base of «4213» with enclitic adverb of origin; from which (as interrogative) or what (as relative) place, state, source or cause:--whence.

G4160.et: apparently a prolonged form of an obsolete primary
G4160.def: apparently a prolonged form of an obsolete primary; to make or do (in a very wide application, more or less direct):--abide, + agree, appoint, × avenge, + band together, be, bear, + bewray, bring (forth), cast out, cause, commit, + content, continue, deal, + without any delay, (would) do(-ing), execute, exercise, fulfil, gain, give, have, hold, × journeying, keep, + lay wait, + lighten the ship, make, × mean, + none of these things move me, observe, ordain, perform, provide, + have purged, purpose, put, + raising up, × secure, shew, × shoot out, spend, take, tarry, + transgress the law, work, yield. Compare «4238».

G4161.def: from «4160»; a product, i.e. fabric (literally or figuratively):--thing that is made, workmanship.

G4162.def: from «4160»; action, i.e. performance (of the law):--deed.

G4163.def: from «4160»; a performer; specially, a "poet"; --doer, poet.

G4164.def: of uncertain derivation; motley, i.e. various in character:--divers, manifold.

G4165.def: from «4166»; to tend as a shepherd of (figuratively, superviser):--feed (cattle), rule.

G4166.def: of uncertain affinity; a shepherd (literally or figuratively):--shepherd, pastor.

G4167.def: contraction from «4165»; a flock (literally or figuratively):--flock, fold.

G4168.et: neuter of a presumed derivative of (4167)
G4168.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of «4167»; a flock, i.e. (figuratively) group (of believers):--flock.

G4169.def: from the base of «4226» and «3634»; individualizing interrogative (of character) what sort of, or (of number) which one:--what (manner of), which.

G4170.def: from «4171»; to be (engaged) in warfare, i.e. to battle (literally or figuratively): -fight, (make) war.

G4171.def: from pelomai (to bustle); warfare (literally or figuratively; a single encounter or a series):--battle, fight, war.

G4172.et: probably from the same as (4171), or perhaps from (4183)
G4172.def: probably from the same as «4171», or perhaps from «4183»; a town (properly, with walls, of greater or less size):--city.

G4173.def: from «4172» and «757»; a town-officer, i.e. magistrate:--ruler of the city.

G4174.def: from «4177» ("polity"); citizenship; concretely, a community:--commonwealth, freedom.

G4176.et: middle voice of a derivative of (4177)
G4176.def: middle voice of a derivative of «4177»; to behave as a citizen (figuratively):--let conversation be, live.

G4178.def: multiplicative adverb from «4183»; many times, i.e. frequently:--oft(-en, -entimes, -times).

G4179.et: from (4183) and probably a derivative of (4120)
G4179.def: from «4183» and probably a derivative of «4120»; manifold, i.e. (neuter as noun) very much more:--manifold more.

G4180.def: from a compound of «4183» and «3056»; loquacity, i.e. prolixity:--much speaking.

G4181.def: adverb from a compound of «4183» and «3313»; in many portions, i.e. variously as to time and agency (piecemeal):--at sundry times.

G4182.def: from «4183» and «4164»; much variegated, i.e. multifarious:--manifold.

G4183.et: including the forms from the alternate pollos
G4183.def: including the forms from the alternate pollos; (singular) much (in any respect) or (plural) many; neuter (singular) as adverbial, largely; neuter (plural) as adverb or noun often, mostly, largely:--abundant, + altogether, common, + far (passed, spent), (+ be of a) great (age, deal, -ly, while), long, many, much, oft(-en (-times)), plenteous, sore, straitly. Compare «4118», «4119».

G4185.def: from «4183» and «5056»; extremely expensive:--costly, very precious, of great price.

G4186.def: from «4183» and «5092»; extremely valuable:--very costly, of great price.

G4187.def: adverb from a compound of «4183» and «5158»; in many ways, i.e. variously as to method or form:--in divers manners.

G4188.def: from the alternate of «4095»; a beverage:--drink.

G4189.def: from «4190»; depravity, i.e. (specially), malice; plural (concretely) plots, sins:--iniquity, wickedness.

G4190.def: from a derivative of «4192»; hurtful, i.e. evil (properly, in effect or influence, and thus differing from «2556», which refers rather to essential character, as well as from «4550», which indicates degeneracy from original virtue); figuratively, calamitous; also (passively) ill, i.e. diseased; but especially (morally) culpable, i.e. derelict, vicious, facinorous; neuter (singular) mischief, malice, or (plural) guilt; masculine (singular) the devil, or (plural) sinners:--bad, evil, grievous, harm, lewd, malicious, wicked(-ness). See also «4191».

G4192.def: from the base of «3993»; toil, i.e. (by implication) anguish:--pain.

G4193.def: from «4195»; a Pontican, i.e. native of Pontus:--born in Pontus.

G4194.def: of Latin origin; apparently bridged; Pontius, a Roman:--Pontius.

G4195.def: a sea; Pontus, a region of Asia Minor:--Pontus.

G4196.def: of Latin origin; apparently "popular"; Poplius (i.e. Publius), a Roman:--Publius.

G4197.pos:
1. a journey
  2. a going, that is: purpose, pursuit, undertaking
G4197.def: from «4198»; travel (by land); figuratively (plural) proceedings, i.e. career:--journey(-ing), ways.

G4198.et: middle voice from a derivative of the same as (3984)
G4198.def: middle voice from a derivative of the same as «3984»; to traverse, i.e. travel (literally or figuratively; especially to remove (figuratively, die), live, etc.); --depart, go (away, forth, one's way, up), (make a, take a) journey, walk.

G4199.def: prolongation from pertho (to sack); to ravage (figuratively):--destroy, waste.
